summary: Step 2 continuation of #1887's exact P/¬P at one rigid, actual foundational n (not a new proposition): docs/notes/foundational-absence-warrant.md §11. Differentiated G0 (objective reality constraint on genuine possibility), G1 (positive possibility-maker) and G2 (PGP's exhaustive in-subject or POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 channels for possible absence). Pruss's 2008 account itself distinguishes necessitarian restrictive-essence and possibilitarian power-based actualisms: G0 cannot settle the possibility of n's absence. Positive argument reconstructs explanatory warrant from dependent beings while identifying its open subjectless generalization; rebuttal distinguishes another-world nonexistence from a transition, and presses the act-essence objection to EC without treating AN 823d4312/565ccd6c as established. Same-n parity retained; no novel Lean, result, modal framework, source claim, statement or definition added: existing 1e6174ab, 39df9612, 872a3832, conditionalIdentity, BruteFoundationalModel and Pruss separation controls exhaust current typed discrimination.
